visual.general_description: Two axial pelvic MRI slices, A and B, each with a red arrow pointing at a large oval structure, dark in A and bright in B.
visual.detailed_description: Side-by-side grayscale axial pelvic MRI slices labeled A (left) and B (right) in white letters. In A a large well-circumscribed oval structure is uniformly very dark; in B a large well-circumscribed oval structure is bright and fairly homogeneous. A red arrow at the upper left of each panel points at the anterior margin of the structure. A rounded granular structure lies posterior to it in each panel and the bony pelvis, muscle and fat surround them. No scale bar, side marker or other text is visible.
